content: Layered test strategy for App Router: (1) Unit = Vitest (Vite-native, ESM, Vercel's current guidance): server actions as plain async functions, zod schemas, pure helpers, sync components. (2) Integration = route handlers + real test database, catching schema/constraint issues mocks miss — don't mock the DB here. (3) E2E = Playwright for async Server Components (Vitest cannot render them — hard line) and full auth flows; run against production build; never mock server actions in E2E. Mocking: vitest.setup.ts with vi.mock for next/headers, next/navigation (redirect MUST throw to avoid false positives), next/cache (revalidatePath), server-only. Prisma unit mocks via vitest-mock-extended mockDeep (deep nested prisma.x.y methods). Server-action test matrix per protected action: anonymous, invalid input, wrong owner (IDOR), admin override.
